mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password Hashing Policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use argon2id for password hashing. argon2id is a memory-hard key derivation function, chosen because its high memory requirements resist GPU-based brute-force attacks and its constant-time operation resists side-channel timing attacks. No parameter values (memory cost, iterations, parallelism, salt or output length) are recorded, so none are specified here.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md
